structuredContent.body:
Adopts published DEVAI 2.7.0 / Constitution 1.1.0 through the supported governed migration and retains a complete, source-bound M1 reassessment. Original acceptance criteria and local/history custody remain intact.

- Official six-file materialization, 121 provider-owned schemas, finite ADR-0062 historical compatibility and adversarial tests. Original runtime graph, seven task descriptors, assertions, thresholds and N/A declarations preserved.
- Docs-only fast-uri 3.1.9 repair clears the new advisory; body-parser 1.20.9 remains. Prior failed captures, refusals and partial source-74 assessment stay preserved.
- Exact measured source `21427c25fe2e1c7977ca0311156d4c59d8cfea35`: all **43 applicable cells measured, zero observation gaps**, plus two unchanged N/A. Native quality **26 PASS / 12 REVIEW / 5 FAIL, overall FAIL**. All seven original BL-0024 gaps have supported dispositions; remaining quality findings stay open.
- Unit **13,641**, integration **1,518**, complete E2E **2,260** PASS. Genuine whole-source coverage **56.53%** remains REVIEW. Eight native inventory bodies published and strictly validated before proof append; no cross-source cell pooling.
- All 55 new reading artifacts officially recorded and matched in both directions; exact chain append 393→448, all 268 baseline canonical files unchanged. Lossless archive retains all 490 capture-time artifacts, including 85 raw task/coverage outputs. Independent Auditor's complete register, comparison, manifest and separate remediation dispositions are committed.
- Same 13 historical artifact-availability limitations remain explicit, distinct from native 128 proof anchors / 53 acknowledged historical proof gaps. Six runner-review limitations and two non-cell UNKNOWN diagnostics remain disclosed.
- R-0043/BL-0016 bounded #218 mock repair is officially closed/sealed as PC-0026. BL-0025 stays open; the new E2E PASS does not diagnose the old socket failure. R-0042/BL-0024 remain open until actual integration and a separate official closeout.
- #211 remains **unmerged**, S3 runtime held; all nine C6 producers inactive with effective bindings empty. R-0020/0041/0044/0045 and product/legal/operational obligations remain separate.

Final delivery head: `522e61d39d4a5fb063d29b9d5c58d6543e2a197c`. Affected local law/state/round/proof/doctor/format checks pass; independent cross-family delivery review PASS on this exact commit/tree, with zero actionable blockers; final-head required CI is running. Review receipt retained locally and will accompany the separate closeout packet. Earlier signed RC and independent run 40034673414 bind source80505ac only. This PR's supported verified-local-rc remote backend fallback is distinct from the later fresh signed RC required on the final clean closeout candidate.

Merge with a **merge commit** to retain authentic source Git objects and histories. No source or assessment result is rewritten by integration.
